`interface IResourceFormat`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`ApngResourceFormat`](/reference/resources/apngresourceformat/), [`GifResourceFormat`](/reference/resources/gifresourceformat/), [`HeifResourceFormat`](/reference/resources/heifresourceformat/), [`SvgResourceFormat`](/reference/resources/svgresourceformat/), [`VideoResourceFormat`](/reference/resources/videoresourceformat/), [`WebpResourceFormat`](/reference/resources/webpresourceformat/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.format` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IResourceFormat.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/format/IResourceFormat.java)

Recognizes one file format from its first bytes and creates the decoder that reads it.

## Description

Register it with [`ResourceFormat.register`](/reference/resources/resourceformat/#ResourceFormat-method-register) so that [`Resource.of`](/reference/resources/resource/#Resource-factory-of) reads your format.
JOID calls both methods on the thread that detects the format, often a background thread.

## Method details

<a id="IResourceFormat-method-supports"></a>

### supports

`boolean supports(byte[] header)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

If `true`, this format reads a file that starts with `header`, the first 4096 bytes of the file or fewer.

<a id="IResourceFormat-method-decoder"></a>

### decoder

`IResourceDecoder decoder(Asset asset, byte[] header)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Returns the decoder that reads `asset`; JOID calls it only when `supports` returned `true`.
Throw an exception to make the resource fail with its message.
